en: Each eye of the Philippine tarsier is larger than its entire brain, giving it excellent night vision.
The Rafflesia flower, found in Southeast Asia, can grow up to one meter wide and weigh eleven kilograms.
A human baby is born with around three hundred bones, which fuse together to leave adults with only two hundred six.
The Arctic tern flies over seventy thousand kilometers annually, making it the animal with the longest migration route.
A single average strawberry has approximately two hundred tiny seeds attached to its outside surface, unlike most other fruits.
If laid end to end, the blood vessels in an average adult human body would stretch about one hundred thousand kilometers.
A thirsty dromedary camel can drink up to one hundred liters of water in just ten minutes to survive the desert.
Periodical cicadas spend either thirteen or seventeen years living underground as nymphs before finally emerging as winged adults.
Despite its extremely long neck, a giraffe has exactly seven neck vertebrae, which is the exact same number humans have.
Certain species of bamboo hold the growth record, capable of growing up to ninety-one centimeters in just one single day.
The average human tongue contains roughly ten thousand taste buds, which completely replace themselves every two weeks.
Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor but provide a habitat for twenty-five percent of all marine species.
